features.text: 15° INCREMENTAL ROM CONTROL: Dual hinges allow fine-tuned motion control for safe rehabilitation progress.
MEDIAL & LATERAL STABILITY: Rigid uprights support the knee against side-to-side motion during recovery.
COMFORTABLE WRAP DESIGN: Adjustable straps and breathable padding ensure a secure, comfortable fit.
POST-INJURY OR POST-OP READY: Ideal for ligament injuries, surgery recovery, and chronic knee instability.
PRECISION ALIGNMENT: Helps maintain natural knee tracking during activity and rehabilitation.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
